items.desc_en: At Salesforce's annual mega-conference in San Francisco, attendees said they get enough value from older AI models.
items.desc_zh: 在旧金山举行的 Salesforce 年度大型会议上，与会者表示，他们从旧的人工智能模型中获得了足够的价值。

items.title_en: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
items.title_zh: 马克龙表示，俄罗斯对欧洲的混合攻击正在加剧
items.desc_en: The French president says he has tasked the government with protecting critical infrastructure and defence industry sites.
items.desc_zh: 法国总统表示，他已责成政府保护关键基础设施和国防工业场所。

items.title_en: Police begin operation to move migrants from Ceuta beaches
items.title_zh: 警方开始行动从休达海滩转移移民
items.desc_en: Police reportedly fired into the air on Friday morning as they struggled to contain crowds jostling to secure a place at the tented site.
items.desc_zh: 据报道，周五早上，警方向空中开枪，当时他们正在努力控制人群，争先恐后地在帐篷营地占据一席之地。

items.title_en: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
items.title_zh: 林赛·克兰西坚持不懈的陪审员毫不怀疑她故意杀害了自己的孩子
items.desc_en: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.
items.desc_zh: 这是这位拒绝站在其他人一边并宣告克兰西无罪的陪审员第一次公开谈论他的决定。

items.title_en: At least 16 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams into Pakistan mosque
items.title_zh: 巴基斯坦清真寺遭满载炸药车辆冲撞 至少16人死亡
items.desc_en: A vehicle loaded with explosives rammed into a mosque building during Friday prayers, a senior police official says.
items.desc_zh: 一名高级警官称，周五祈祷期间，一辆满载炸药的车辆撞向一座清真寺建筑。
